setup: Copy the fixture directory to a temp dir, run `git init`, `git remote add origin git@github.com:example-org/<fixture>.git`, commit everything, then run the prompt from that directory.

evals.expected_output: Report with all 8 gates PRESENT locally and in CI, verdict COMPLIANT, coverage threshold 85%, 'Suggestions (optional)' section saying 'No suggestions.'.
expectations: Terminal output is exactly the 3 fixed lines (start, Collecting facts..., ✅ Report ready) with no other chat text
Writes python-quality-gates-report.md in the repository root
Title is '# Python Quality Gates Report: example-org/modern-ruff'
Section 2 and section 3 list all 8 gates as PRESENT; Security and Complexity tools are ruff
Coverage row shows threshold 85%
Verdict is COMPLIANT with 'Mandatory gates enforced in CI: 5/5.'
Suggestions section says 'No suggestions.'
Report contains no emoji and no <details> blocks
No project file other than the report is created or modified

evals.expected_output: Linter OVERLAP (pylint, flake8) locally and in CI via tox; Type checker and Dependency audit MISSING; radon present locally but only in a scheduled workflow, so Complexity MISSING in CI; verdict PARTIAL 4/5; migration recommendations for black, flake8, pylint, bandit, radon plus a coverage threshold recommendation.
expectations: Linter is OVERLAP with pylint and flake8 in both section 2 and section 3
CI evidence for lint/format/tests resolves through tox (mentions tox.ini) and does not cite the `pip install tox` line
Type checker is MISSING locally and in CI
Complexity is PRESENT locally (radon) and MISSING in CI, with evidence noting the nightly workflow is not on pull_request/push
Verdict is PARTIAL with 4/5 mandatory gates enforced
Recommendations include one grouped ruff item replacing black, flake8, pylint, bandit and radon
Recommendations include setting a coverage threshold (fail_under = 80)

evals.expected_output: Same stack as modern-ruff but with a coverage threshold of 60%; all gates PRESENT, verdict COMPLIANT, and a 'Suggestions (optional)' item to raise the threshold to at least 80.
expectations: Coverage row shows threshold 60%
Verdict is still COMPLIANT (a low threshold never changes gate status or verdict)
Heading is 'Suggestions (optional)' and contains an item to raise the coverage threshold to at least 80, mentioning the current value 60

evals.expected_output: ruff (Linter, Formatter) and pytest PRESENT locally; everything MISSING in CI; verdict NON-COMPLIANT 0/5; recommendations to run ruff/pytest in CI and set up mypy, coverage, S, pip-audit, C90.
expectations: Section 2 shows Linter, Formatter (ruff) and Test runner (pytest) PRESENT; Type checker and Coverage MISSING
Section 3 shows all 8 gates MISSING
Verdict is NON-COMPLIANT with 0/5
Security is not counted as PRESENT (ruff selects only E and F)
Python versions field mentions requires-python >=3.11

evals.expected_output: Short report stating no Python code was detected; no analysers are spawned.
expectations: Report contains only the title, Repository URL, Scan time and 'No Python code detected in this repository.'
Terminal output omits the 'Running analysers in parallel' line
No subagents are spawned

evals.prompt: Which Python linter should I use for a new project?
evals.expected_output: Skill does not activate; a normal answer is given and no report file is written.
expectations: Does not run scan.py or write python-quality-gates-report.md
Does not print the fixed '🔍 Analysing Python quality gates' line
